subject: general
question: Who formed the Swaraj Party in 1923?

options.text: Subhash Chandra Bose and Bal Gangadhar Tilak

solution:
The correct answer is __**Motilal Nehru and Chittaranjan Das**__ .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Indian National Congress (Congress Party) members Motilal Nehru, one of the most well-known lawyers in northern India, and Chitta Ranjan Das, a nationalist politician from Bengal, founded the Swaraj Party in 1923.
 
• The word "swaraj," which means "self-rule," was used to refer broadly to the campaign for independence from British control and serves as the inspiration for the name of the party.
 
• The party's main objective was to run in the 1923 elections for the new Central Legislative Assembly and, if successful, to use its position of power to agitate against the British administration in India and disrupt official policies.
 
• More than 40 Swarajists were elected to the Central Legislative Assembly in 1923, but their representation was never quite enough to stop the British from passing the legislation they sought or thought was necessary to protect internal order in India. The party was dissolved by 1927.

Thus we know that Swaraj Party was founded in 1923 by Motilal Nehru and C.R. Das.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Chittaranjan Das__:

 
 
• He was popularly called as Deshbandhu.
 
• He defended Aurobindo Ghosh in the 1908 Alipore Bomb Case.
 
• He was the co-founder of the Swarajya Party in 1923 along with Motilal Nehru.
 
• He was the President of the Gaya session of INC in 1922.
 
• He was known as the political guru of Subhas Chandra Bose.
 
 
 
• Motilal Nehru:
 
 
• 1919 session of the congress was held in Amritsar to condemn the Jallianwala Bagh massacre in the city.
 
• The 1919 session was held under the presidentship of Motilal Nehru.
 
• He was the secretary of the Swarajya party formed in the year 1923.
